semantics.reviewed: A fresh human/agent review of named sources; it can retain a conservative conclusion but cannot prove behavior.
semantics.verified: Capability-specific primary documentation or a correlated local/live acceptance record verifies only its declared claim dimension and mode.
semantics.liveAcceptance: An immutable passing artifact binds runtime, capability, mode, correlation id, attempt id, and optional release identity.
